legend: Define a set A$$$A$$$ as a child of set B$$$B$$$ if and only if for each element of value x$$$x$$$ that is in A$$$A$$$, there exists an element of value x+1$$$x+1$$$ that is in B$$$B$$$.

Given integers N$$$N$$$ and K$$$K$$$. In order to make Chaneka happy, you must find the number of different arrays containing N$$$N$$$ sets [S1,S2,S3,…,SN]$$$[S_1, S_2, S_3, \ldots, S_N]$$$ such that: - Each set can only contain zero or more different integers from 1$$$1$$$ to K$$$K$$$. - There exists a way to rearrange the order of the array of sets into [S′1,S′2,S′3,…,S′N]$$$[S'_1, S'_2, S'_3, \ldots, S'_N]$$$ such that S′i$$$S'_i$$$ is a child of S′i+1$$$S'_{i+1}$$$ for each 1≤i≤N−1$$$1\leq i\leq N-1$$$.
Two sets are considered different if and only if there is at least one value that only occurs in one of the two sets.
Two arrays of sets are considered different if and only if there is at least one index i$$$i$$$ such that the sets at index i$$$i$$$ in the two arrays are different.
input: The only line contains two integers N$$$N$$$ and K$$$K$$$ (1≤N,K≤2⋅105$$$1 \leq N,K \leq 2\cdot10^5$$$) — the number of sets in the array and the maximum limit for the values in the sets.
output: An integer representing the number of different arrays of sets that satisfy the problem condition, modulo 998244353$$$998\,244\,353$$$.

给定整数 N$$$N$$$ 和 K$$$K$$$。为了让 Chaneka 开心，你需要求出包含 N$$$N$$$ 个集合 [S1,S2,S3,…,SN]$$$[S_1, S_2, S_3, \ldots, S_N]$$$ 的不同数组的数量，使得：
- 每个集合只能包含从 1$$$1$$$ 到 K$$$K$$$ 中的零个或多个互不相同的整数。
- 存在一种重新排列集合数组顺序的方法，使其变为 [S′1,S′2,S′3,…,S′N]$$$[S'_1, S'_2, S'_3, \ldots, S'_N]$$$，并且对于每个 1≤i≤N−1$$$1\leq i\leq N-1$$$，S′i$$$S'_i$$$ 都是 S′i+1$$$S'_{i+1}$$$ 的子集合。
当且仅当存在至少一个值只出现在两个集合中的一个集合里时，认为两个集合不同。
当且仅当存在至少一个下标 i$$$i$$$，使得两个数组中下标为 i$$$i$$$ 的集合不同时，认为两个集合数组不同。
